releaseNotes:
• Daily Reminder: Resolved hour & minute number clipping on Android with optimized line height and font padding
• Custom Alert Dialog: Integrated custom-styled modal for reminder confirmations replacing native system alerts
• Motivating Notifications: Upgraded daily reminder push notification message to be user-friendly, professional, and encouraging
• Transaction Title Display: Added generous padding and card styling to options in preferences
• Performance optimizations and stability improvements
